name: read-only-complete-control-scope-proposal
scope: One read-only proposal builds directly from all verified original CPU profiles, unchanged independent audit producers/allocations, exact live hardware/dependencies and retained current control use. Keep GPU failures visible and exclude the unqualified variant. Independently recompute twofold complete-process CPU ceilings and enumerate eleven missing primary plus two R1 comparison controls at fixed original seeds/recipes. The default twelve-hour control ceiling remains unchanged; a larger scope requires a separate explicit owner decision bound to the immutable proposal. No full case, target/threshold change, optional work or production/study scope is selected.
